title: a-crossing-is-derived-from-the-journal-never-stored-on-the-ticket
intention: A ticket's `crossings` array stops being stored and becomes DERIVED from the journals. A reader primitive in cairn/tools/base/ joins history.json entries to a ticket on the journal entry's `ticket` field; the six readers call it; the 43 stored arrays are deleted.
why: `crossings` is gate evidence - the facts a gate READS to decide. Measured 2026-09-10: proof_coverage.lacks() walks it for `proven_by` to decide whether a boat is COVERED (and clearance refuses PROVED on an uncovered boat); hollow.py walks it for the latest `to: BUILDME` entry to decide which commit the hollow reading reverts to; codemother/shim.py walks it for `proven_by`; three harbor_master probes read it. It has ZERO writers and SIX readers, so every value in it was typed by a hand - including the six CC typed for dd8ad9702b49 on 2026-09-10. Akien: 'emit cannot create crossings, only a deterministic gate or explicit from me.' Deriving it is not a new writer: every field is already in history.json, written by emit at the instant the gates fired. It also makes the rule physics rather than vigilance - after this there is no way to write a crossing except by crossing, because there is no field left to type one into.
how: (1) A derivation in cairn/tools/base/ (beside the projector that writes the journals; it cannot live in any one reader - proof_coverage is a tool, hollow is a device, shim is a device shim, and cross-device imports are ruled out). Join: journal entry's `ticket` field == the ticket id. (2) Field mapping, measured: date<-at, by<-actor, to/direction/proven_by/note by the same name, journal<-the history.json path itself. (3) `door` IS THE ONE GAP - 98 of 99 stored entries carry it, no journal field is named door (the journal carries clearance_gate/build_gate/exit_gate/emission_gate/gate stamps instead). The build MEASURES whether door is reconstructible from those stamps FIRST. If not, it is dropped and every reader is checked for a dependence; if any reader needs it, that is a RED THAT STOPS AND REPORTS, because inventing a door value is writing gate evidence. (4) Switch all six readers. (5) THEN delete the 43 stored arrays - the deletion is the proof, not the leap. (6) hollow._buildme_at loses its ticket-side fallback (it already prefers the journal).
falsifier: DONE when: (a) the derivation returns, for any ticket id, the crossings the journals hold; (b) all six readers call it instead of ticket.get('crossings'); (c) the stored arrays are removed from all 43 tickets and no check goes red; (d) hollow._buildme_at loses its ticket-side fallback. WRONG INTENT if the derivation reads the stored array as a fallback - a silent preference for the stored copy is the same hand at one remove and would read green forever off the 43 that already have one. The measurement is that ticket JSON no longer contains the key at all, not that a function exists. HORIZON: the next voyage after this one crosses PROVED without any hand touching a crossing.
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy - after this a crossing cannot be typed). Law 7 (history.json is the record of truth; the ticket held a second copy that could contradict it). Law 1 (a settled fact stops being re-derived by a hand 43 times).
